```{=html}
<script>
/* Upgrade <strong> elements in rubric table cells to glossary popup buttons.
   Runs after DOMContentLoaded; relies on event delegation in glossary.js. */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var defs = {
    'rt-list':        'Give a sequence of brief answers with no explanation.',
    'rt-outline':     'Give a brief account or summary.',
    'rt-identify':    'Provide an answer from a number of possibilities.',
    'rt-assemble':    'Combine or gather pre-existing material without change.',
    'rt-approximate': 'Imitate with lack of detail.',
    'rt-reiterate':   'Repeat or restate, largely without change.',
    'rt-describe':    'Give a detailed account.',
    'rt-demonstrate': 'Make clear by reasoning or evidence, illustrating with examples or practical application.',
    'rt-distinguish': 'Make clear the differences between two or more concepts or items.',
    'rt-exhibit':     'Demonstrate a characteristic in the appropriate context.',
    'rt-transmit':    'Give a formulaic rendition of an existing work or style.',
    'rt-recreate':    'Produce a representation of an original.',
    'rt-explain':     'Give a detailed account, including reasons or causes.',
    'rt-investigate': 'Observe, study, or make a detailed and systematic examination in order to establish facts and reach new conclusions.',
    'rt-justify':     'Give valid reasons or evidence to support an answer or conclusion.',
    'rt-realize':     'Plan and create a work according to convention or practice.',
    'rt-shape':       'Modify and develop existing material.',
    'rt-adapt':       'Adjust existing material to suit a new context or style.',
    'rt-discuss':     'Offer a considered and balanced review supported by appropriate evidence.',
    'rt-examine':     'Consider an argument or concept in a way that uncovers the assumptions and interrelationships of the issue.',
    'rt-evaluate':    'Make an appraisal by weighing up the strengths and limitations.',
    'rt-personalize': 'Bring personal ideas and interpretations to a work or practice.',
    'rt-synthesize':  'Combine and blend existing elements, styles, or techniques to create new work.',
    'rt-transform':   'Change and develop existing work to create new work.'
  };
  var wordMap = {
    'lists': 'rt-list', 'list': 'rt-list',
    'outlines': 'rt-outline', 'outline': 'rt-outline',
    'identifies': 'rt-identify',
    'approximates': 'rt-approximate',
    'reiterates': 'rt-reiterate',
    'describes': 'rt-describe', 'describe': 'rt-describe',
    'demonstrates': 'rt-demonstrate',
    'distinguishes': 'rt-distinguish',
    'exhibits': 'rt-exhibit',
    'transmits': 'rt-transmit',
    'recreates': 'rt-recreate',
    'explains': 'rt-explain', 'explain': 'rt-explain',
    'investigates': 'rt-investigate',
    'justifies': 'rt-justify',
    'realizes': 'rt-realize',
    'shapes': 'rt-shape',
    'adapts': 'rt-adapt',
    'discusses': 'rt-discuss',
    'examines': 'rt-examine',
    'evaluates': 'rt-evaluate',
    'personalizes': 'rt-personalize',
    'synthesizes': 'rt-synthesize',
    'transforms': 'rt-transform'
  };
  var glossaryUrl = 'glossary.html';
  document.querySelectorAll('td strong, td b').forEach(function (strong) {
    var word = strong.textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
    var slug = wordMap[word];
    if (!slug) return;
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'glossary';
    btn.setAttribute('data-term', slug);
    btn.setAttribute('data-def', defs[slug]);
    btn.setAttribute('data-glossary-url', glossaryUrl);
    var defSpan = document.createElement('span');
    defSpan.className = 'def';
    defSpan.textContent = defs[slug];
    btn.appendChild(defSpan);
    btn.appendChild(document.createTextNode(strong.textContent));
    strong.parentNode.replaceChild(btn, strong);
  });

  // ── Arrival handler: #sectionid,rt-term → scroll to section, highlight button ──
  var hash = window.location.hash.slice(1);
  if (hash.includes(',')) {
    var parts = hash.split(',');
    var sectionId = parts[0];
    var termId    = parts[1];
    history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname + window.location.search);
    var section = document.getElementById(sectionId);
    if (section) {
      section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      var allBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button.glossary[data-term="' + termId + '"]'));
      var btn = allBtns.find(function (b) {
        return !!(section.compareDocumentPosition(b) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING);
      });
      if (btn) { btn.classList.add('glterm-highlight'); }
    }
  }
});
</script>
```

## Exploring Music in Context

*Guidance on what each level means: [What Each Level Means](../book/exploring-criterion-guidance.html) · [Common Mistakes](../book/exploring-common-mistakes.html)*

### Criterion A: Selection of Evidence {#emc-a}

This criterion focuses on the diversity, breadth and balance of the chosen material that the student selects as evidence in the portfolio.

For the purpose of this task:

- **diversity** and **breadth** are achieved by a choice of contrasting materials from personal, local and global contexts in at least two areas of inquiry

- **balance** is achieved by equity in the treatment of the areas of inquiry studied and the treatment of contexts across the portfolio.

**Well-chosen** and **appropriate** evidence clearly supports the musical and extra-musical findings of the exploration.

***Guiding questions***

Does the student explore diverse musical material?

Is evidence well-chosen and appropriate to the exploration?

+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| **Marks**              | **Level Descriptors**                                                                                                                | **Possible Characteristics**         |
+:======================:+======================================================================================================================================+:====================================:+
| 0                      | The work does not reach a standard described by the descriptors below.                                                               |                                      |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 1-2                    | - The student's exploration does not refer to diverse musical material.                                                              | Ineffective                          |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The evidence in the portfolio is **ineffective** and/or **rudimentary.**                                                           | Inaccurate                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Rudimentary                          |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Limited                              |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Superficial                          |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 3-4                    | - The student's exploration refers to diverse musical material.                                                                      | Inconsistent                         |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The evidence in the portfolio is **suitable** but **inconsistently** balanced.                                                     | Formulaic                            |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Sufficient                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Suitable                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Reasonable                           |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 5-6                    | - The student's exploration refers to diverse musical material.                                                                      | Accurate                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The evidence in the portfolio is **relevant** and **purposefully** balanced.                                                       | Proficient                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Purposeful                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Relevant                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Competent                            |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+

### Criterion B1: Conducting Musical Research {#emc-b1}

This criterion focuses on how well students **extract musical** and extra-musical findings, and how well they locate and explain these findings.

***Guiding question***

How well does the student communicate the findings?

How effective are the selected findings?

Does the student use accurate terminology?

How effectively does the student locate the **musical findings**?

+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| **Marks**              | **Level Descriptors**                                                                                                                | **Possible Characteristics**         |
+:======================:+======================================================================================================================================+:====================================:+
| 0                      | The work does not reach a standard described by the descriptors below.                                                               |                                      |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 1-3                    | - The student **lists** musical and extra-musical findings.                                                                          | Ineffective                          |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The selected findings are **superficial**.                                                                                         | Inaccurate                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - Terminology is **inaccurate** throughout.                                                                                          | Rudimentary                          |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The student **inaccurately** locates musical findings in the chosen sources.                                                       | Limited                              |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Superficial                          |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 4-6                    | - The student **describes** musical and extra-musical findings.                                                                      | Inconsistent                         |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The selected findings are **reasonable**.                                                                                          | Formulaic                            |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - Terminology is **inconsistent** throughout.                                                                                        | Sufficient                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The student **inconsistently** locates musical findings in the chosen sources.                                                     | Suitable                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Reasonable                           |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 7-9                    | - The student **explains** musical and extra-musical findings.                                                                       | Accurate                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The selected findings are **purposeful**.                                                                                          | Proficient                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - Terminology is **accurate** throughout.                                                                                            | Purposeful                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The student **accurately** locates musical findings in the chosen sources.                                                         | Relevant                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Competent                            |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+

## Experimenting with Music

*Guidance on what each level means: [What Each Level Means](../book/ewm-criterion-guidance.html) · [Common Mistakes](../book/ewm-common-mistakes.html)*

### Criterion A: Rationale and commentary for musical experiments in creating {#ewm-a}

This criterion focuses on the articulation of a persuasive and logical rationale for musical experiments in creating supported by a relevant selection of stimuli for experimentation. The commentary
should clearly evidence and explain the musical decision-making processes that have guided the experimentation. For the purpose of this task, students provide:

- a rationale that justifies the choices of source material, including the choice of contexts and areas of inquiry

- a commentary that explains the experimentation process and the evolution of the experimentation stimuli.

***Guiding questions***

How well has the student justified their proposed experimentation and supported this with relevant source material and musical stimuli?

Is the explanation of the experimentation process and of musical decision-making convincing?

+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| **Marks**              | **Level Descriptors**                                                                                                                | **Possible Characteristics**         |
+:======================:+======================================================================================================================================+:====================================:+
| 0                      | The work does not reach a standard described by the descriptors below.                                                               |                                      |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 1-2                    | - The student's rationale for musical experiments in creating is **ineffective**.                                                    | Ineffective                          |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The student **outlines** the experimentation process with **rudimentary** musical decision-making.                                 | Inaccurate                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Rudimentary                          |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Limited                              |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Superficial                          |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 3-4                    | - The student's rationale for musical experiments in creating is **suitable**.                                                       | Inconsistent                         |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The student **describes** the experimentation process with **reasonable** musical decision-making.                                 | Formulaic                            |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Sufficient                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Suitable                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Reasonable                           |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 5-6                    | - The student's rationale for musical experiments in creating is **purposeful**.                                                     | Accurate                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The student **explains** the experimentation process with **relevant** musical decision-making.                                    | Proficient                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - The student **evaluates** the experimentation process.                                                                             | Purposeful                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Relevant                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Competent                            |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+

### Criterion B: Practical musical experiments in creating {#ewm-b}

This criterion focuses on the processes of musical experimentation in creating that generate innovative musical ideas with personal intent and purpose, resulting from informed musical decision-making.

***Guiding questions***

How effectively has the student conducted a series of purposeful musical experiments?\
Is there practical evidence of informed musical decision-making in the musical experimentation process?

+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| **Marks**              | **Level Descriptors**                                                                                                                | **Possible Characteristics**         |
+:======================:+======================================================================================================================================+:====================================:+
| 0                      | The work does not reach a standard described by the descriptors below.                                                               |                                      |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 1-2                    | - The student **reiterates** source material, and the development of musical ideas is **limited**.                                   | Ineffective                          |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - Practical evidence of musical decision-making is **superficial**.                                                                  | Inaccurate                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Rudimentary                          |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Limited                              |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Superficial                          |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 3-4                    | - The student **recreates** source material, and the development of musical ideas is **formulaic**.                                  | Inconsistent                         |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - Practical evidence of musical decision-making is **inconsistent**.                                                                 | Formulaic                            |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Sufficient                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Suitable                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Reasonable                           |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 5-6                    | - The student **adapts** source materials, and the development of musical ideas is **purposeful**.                                   | Accurate                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - Practical evidence of musical decision-making is **proficient**.                                                                   | Proficient                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Purposeful                           |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Relevant                             |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Competent                            |
+------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
| 7-8                    | - The student **transforms** source material, and the development of musical ideas is **imaginative**.                               | Imaginative                          |
|                        |                                                                                                                                      |                                      |
|                        | - Practical evidence of musical decision-making is **compelling**.                                                                   | Resourceful                          |

|                        |                                                                                                                                      | Compelling                           |
